ticket.title: add .editorconfig
ticket.body: We don't have a shared editor config in the repo, so everyone's indentation and line endings drift depending on their editor defaults. Add a basic .editorconfig with 2-space indent, LF line endings, and trim trailing whitespace. No behavior changes, just an editor hint file.

ticket.title: Bump lodash to 4.17.21
ticket.body: We're still pinned to lodash 4.17.15 in package.json. Bump it to 4.17.21 to pick up the prototype pollution fixes from the last couple of point releases. Ran the test suite locally against the bump and nothing broke.

ticket.title: Rename usrId to userId in the session module
Fix typo in README installation section
ticket.body: The install instructions say `pip install requirements.txt` but it should be `pip install -r requirements.txt` -- as written it just tries to install a package literally named requirements.txt. One-line fix in README.md.

ticket.title: Tighten ESLint max-len rule to 100
ticket.body: Our style guide says 100 characters but .eslintrc still has max-len set to 120 from an old default. Tighten it to 100 to match. Config-only change, no source files touched.

ticket.title: Export button does nothing on Safari
ticket.body: Clicking Export on the reports page has no effect in Safari 17 -- no download, no error toast, nothing. Works fine in Chrome and Firefox on the same machine. The Safari console shows `TypeError: undefined is not a constructor (evaluating 'new Blob(...)')`.

ticket.title: Totals on the report page differ from the CSV export for the same date range
ticket.body: Filtering the dashboard to last month shows a total of $4,821.03 at the top of the page. Exporting the same date range to CSV and summing the rows gives $4,798.50 instead. Both should be reading the same underlying transactions, so one of the two is dropping something.

ticket.title: Duplicate rows appear after refresh on the inventory table
ticket.body: Every row in the inventory table sometimes doubles up after a page refresh, until I do a hard reload. It doesn't happen every time -- maybe one in five refreshes. Started happening after last week's deploy.

ticket.title: Scheduled reports arrive an hour early after the DST change
ticket.body: Weekly reports are configured to send at 9am local time for each customer. Since the daylight saving time change last weekend, they've been landing in inboxes at 8am instead. Looks like the scheduler is using a stale UTC offset.

ticket.title: Password reset emails sometimes never arrive
ticket.body: About 1 in 20 users report that the 'forgot password' email never shows up, even after retrying and checking spam. Nothing unusual is logged in our mail provider's dashboard for those sends. Hard to reproduce on demand.

ticket.title: Fix the export flow to also support CSV
ticket.body: Right now the export flow only produces a PDF summary. Several customers have asked for a raw CSV download too, so they can pull the numbers into their own spreadsheets. Nothing about the current PDF export is broken -- this is purely additive.

ticket.title: Add a dark mode toggle to settings
ticket.body: A few people in the community forum have asked for a dark theme. Proposal: add a toggle under Settings > Appearance that switches the whole app to a dark color scheme, remembered per user. Happy to help with the color palette if useful.

ticket.title: Support bulk-exporting multiple projects at once
ticket.body: Today you can only export one project's report at a time, which is painful for anyone managing more than a handful of projects. Add a way to select several projects and export them all in a single zip file.

ticket.title: Ability to mute notifications for a specific project
ticket.body: It would be great to mute notifications from just one noisy project without turning off notifications globally. There's no way to do this today -- could we add a per-project mute toggle in the project settings menu?

ticket.title: Add webhook support for task completion events
ticket.body: We'd like to register a webhook URL that gets POSTed to whenever a task is marked complete, so we can wire it into our internal Slack bot. This doesn't need to be configurable per-task at first -- one webhook URL per workspace is enough to start.
